paper_statement: Appendix F gives differentiable soft-binning implementations of canonical, class-wise, and top-label ECL.

machine_check.dataset: official hash-audited MNIST: 60000 training and 10000 held-out test images
machine_check.models: two label-trained multinomial logistic models on disjoint 30000-image training halves
machine_check.domains: positive source and target weights on every held-out image, determined from X pixels only
formulations: top-label: 15 Gaussian soft bins over max score and posterior of the predicted class
class-wise: 15 Gaussian soft bins independently for every one of 10 classes
canonical: shifted simplex-grid Gaussian bins over the full 10-dimensional score
machine_check.differentiability_test: PyTorch autograd derivative with respect to score temperature must match an independent centered NumPy finite difference for every formulation

required_controls: training halves are disjoint and test data are held out
domain selection does not use labels
detaching scores removes the temperature gradient
shuffling posterior values changes every loss
class-wise and canonical losses do not collapse to top-label
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if all three real-data losses are finite and nonzero, all three gradients are finite and nonzero, the independent checker agrees within preregistered tolerances, and every control passes.
excluded_claims: equivalence to the paper's deep digit architectures
